title: Exact ratio (dimensionless, 0-1)
description: A decimal string fraction on the 0-1 scale: a fraction of a position to close (executor TakeProfitDefinition.fraction, ScaleLevel.fraction) or a funding rate expressed per interval (markets FundingRate.Rate, a fraction such as 0.0001). Range is NOT enforced by the type because a ratio MAY legitimately be negative (funding) and MAY exceed 1 in a ratio-of-ratios; each field documents its own range.
